recipe.control: Normal source-grounded discovery resolving releases/APIs/domains/units as it proceeds.
recipe.treatment: Bind chosen release/API/default behavior/unit/type/applicability before dependent derivations; resolve incompatible versions rather than generalizing. Preserve full discovery and implementation/history scope.

selection_basis: unqualified operational diagnostic; no source-quality or speed claim
latency_boundary: earliest actual T3 requestedAt for first stage through complete native terminal and T3 delivery, maximum 2700s including queue/start/retries/retrieval; stage allocation includes delivery; no clock reset
reserve_policy: research preserves 600s critic +900s final; critic preserves 900s final; no writing-stage admission after envelope exhaustion
expiry_policy: one lifecycle-only save/deliver steer at real expiry, at most 60s grace, owned task_cancel if live; no substantive extension
output_scope: FULL original O1-O6 and all in-scope plan sections; complete proposed-change artifact, options, retained/rejected dispositions, criticism dispositions, uncertainty, validation proposed/executed
output_contract: authored artifact.md + source-map.json with immutable captured public bytes and identity metadata; alternatively full native final answer mechanically saved verbatim, never a summary substituted for full output

tool_policy.isolation_limit: T3 freshness excludes parent history; full-access filesystem not a security firewall; no evaluator exists until both arms quiet; forbidden sibling paths explicitly excluded
tool_policy.execution: no downloaded source execution/installers on host; bounded qualified sandbox only if separately admitted

common_lifecycle_carrier.native_route: actual Codex create_goal/get active/update complete/get terminal on same fresh Goal; <=4000char objective
common_lifecycle_carrier.host_carrier: one passive export per activation or terminal event; Codex actual native Goal state projection, not raw tool bodies
common_lifecycle_carrier.absence_policy: actual active/terminal state absent -> lifecycle HOLD; no fake proof
common_lifecycle_carrier.scientific_delivery: complete artifact.md + source-map.json/captured source bytes; complete native output fallback verbatim accepted; concise path/status final after actual terminal
common_lifecycle_carrier.cost: host export setup/invocation separate; native usage fields distinct and unknown null
